hebrewText: וַ/יִּֽירְא֣וּ הַ/מַּלָּחִ֗ים וַֽ/יִּזְעֲקוּ֮ אִ֣ישׁ אֶל אֱלֹהָי/ו֒ וַ/יָּטִ֨לוּ אֶת הַ/כֵּלִ֜ים אֲשֶׁ֤ר בָּֽ/אֳנִיָּה֙ אֶל הַ/יָּ֔ם לְ/הָקֵ֖ל מֵֽ/עֲלֵי/הֶ֑ם וְ/יוֹנָ֗ה יָרַד֙ אֶל יַרְכְּתֵ֣י הַ/סְּפִינָ֔ה וַ/יִּשְׁכַּ֖ב וַ/יֵּרָדַֽם

tokens.bdb: to fear; morally, to revere; caus. to frighten
tokens.kjv: affright, be (make) afraid, dread(-ful), (put in) fear(-ful, -fully, -ing), (be had in) reverence(-end), [idiom] see, terrible (act, -ness, thing).

tokens.bdb: a sailor (as following 'the salt')
tokens.kjv: mariner.

tokens.bdb: to shriek (from anguish or danger); by analogy, (as a herald) to announce or convene publicly
tokens.kjv: assemble, call (together), (make a) cry (out), come with such a company, gather (together), cause to be proclaimed.

tokens.bdb: a man as an individual or a male person; often used as an adjunct to a more definite term (and in such cases frequently not expressed in translation)
tokens.kjv: also, another, any (man), a certain, [phrase] champion, consent, each, every (one), fellow, (foot-, husband-) man, (good-, great, mighty) man, he, high (degree), him (that is), husband, man(-kind), [phrase] none, one, people, person, [phrase] steward, what (man) soever, whoso(-ever), worthy. Compare H802 (אִשָּׁה).
tokens.enLiteralWord: a man as an individual or a male person; often used as an adjunct to a more definite term
tokens.explanation: ish — homem, varão, marido, indivíduo, alguém
tokens.explanationEn: a man as an individual or a male person; often used as an adjunct to a more definite term

tokens.bdb: near, with or among; often in general, to
tokens.kjv: about, according to, after, against, among, as for, at, because(-fore, -side), both...and, by, concerning, for, from, [idiom] hath, in(-to), near, (out) of, over, through, to(-ward), under, unto, upon, whether, with(-in).
tokens.explanation: el — preposição de direção: a, para, em direção a

tokens.bdb: gods in the ordinary sense; but specifically used (in the plural thus, especially with the article) of the supreme God; occasionally applied by way of deference to magistrates; and sometimes as a superlative
tokens.kjv: angels, [idiom] exceeding, God (gods) (-dess, -ly), [idiom] (very) great, judges, [idiom] mighty.
tokens.enLiteralWord: gods in the ordinary sense; but specifically used (in the plural thus
tokens.explanation: Elohim — nome hebraico de Deus. Plural de majestade. Denota o único Deus verdadeiro
tokens.explanationEn: gods in the ordinary sense; but specifically used (in the plural thus

tokens.bdb: to pitch over or reel; hence (transitively) to cast down or out
tokens.kjv: carry away, (utterly) cast (down, forth, out), send out.
tokens.ptLiteralWord: to pitch over or reel; hence  to cast down or out
tokens.enLiteralWord: to pitch over or reel; hence  to cast down or out
tokens.explanation: to pitch over or reel; hence  to cast down or out
tokens.explanationEn: to pitch over or reel; hence  to cast down or out

tokens.bdb: properly, self (but generally used to point out more definitely the object of a verb or preposition, even or namely)
tokens.kjv: (as such unrepresented in English).
tokens.explanation: et — partícula de objeto direto, sem tradução literal em português

tokens.bdb: something prepared, i.e. any apparatus (as an implement, utensil, dress, vessel or weapon)
tokens.kjv: armour(-bearer), artillery, bag, carriage, [phrase] furnish, furniture, instrument, jewel, that is made of, [idiom] one from another, that which pertaineth, pot, [phrase] psaltery, sack, stuff, thing, tool, vessel, ware, weapon, [phrase] whatsoever.

tokens.bdb: who, which, what, that; also (as an adverb and a conjunction) when, where, how, because, in order that, etc.
tokens.kjv: [idiom] after, [idiom] alike, as (soon as), because, [idiom] every, for, [phrase] forasmuch, [phrase] from whence, [phrase] how(-soever), [idiom] if, (so) that ((thing) which, wherein), [idiom] though, [phrase] until, [phrase] whatsoever, when, where ([phrase] -as, -in, -of, -on, -soever, -with), which, whilst, [phrase] whither(-soever), who(-m, -soever, -se). As it is indeclinable, it is often accompanied by the personal pronoun expletively, used to show the connection.
tokens.explanation: asher — pronome relativo: que, quem, o qual, cujo

tokens.bdb: a ship
tokens.kjv: ship(-men).

tokens.bdb: near, with or among; often in general, to
tokens.kjv: about, according to, after, against, among, as for, at, because(-fore, -side), both...and, by, concerning, for, from, [idiom] hath, in(-to), near, (out) of, over, through, to(-ward), under, unto, upon, whether, with(-in).
tokens.explanation: el — preposição de direção: a, para, em direção a

tokens.bdb: a sea (as breaking in noisy surf) or large body of water; specifically (with the article), the Mediterranean Sea; sometimes a large river, or an artifical basin; locally, the west, or (rarely) the south
tokens.kjv: sea ([idiom] -faring man, (-shore)), south, west (-ern, side, -ward).
tokens.enLiteralWord: a sea  or large body of water; specifically
tokens.explanation: yam — mar, lago, oceano, ocidente (o mar fica a oeste)
tokens.explanationEn: a sea  or large body of water; specifically

tokens.bdb: to be (causatively, make) light, literally (swift, small, sharp, etc.) or figuratively (easy, trifling, vile, etc.)
tokens.kjv: abate, make bright, bring into contempt, (ac-) curse, despise, (be) ease(-y, -ier), (be a, make, make somewhat, move, seem a, set) light(-en, -er, -ly, -ly afflict, -ly esteem, thing), [idiom] slight(-ly), be swift(-er), (be, be more, make, re-) vile, whet.

tokens.bdb: above, over, upon, or against (yet always in this last relation with a downward aspect) in a great variety of applications
tokens.kjv: above, according to(-ly), after, (as) against, among, and, [idiom] as, at, because of, beside (the rest of), between, beyond the time, [idiom] both and, by (reason of), [idiom] had the charge of, concerning for, in (that), (forth, out) of, (from) (off), (up-) on, over, than, through(-out), to, touching, [idiom] with.
tokens.explanation: al — sobre, acima, contra, em relação a

tokens.bdb: Jonah, an Israelite
tokens.kjv: Jonah.

tokens.bdb: to descend (literally, to go downwards; or conventionally to a lower region, as the shore, a boundary, the enemy, etc.; or figuratively, to fall); causatively, to bring down (in all the above applications)
tokens.kjv: [idiom] abundantly, bring down, carry down, cast down, (cause to) come(-ing) down, fall (down), get down, go(-ing) down(-ward), hang down, [idiom] indeed, let down, light (down), put down (off), (cause to, let) run down, sink, subdue, take down.

tokens.bdb: near, with or among; often in general, to
tokens.kjv: about, according to, after, against, among, as for, at, because(-fore, -side), both...and, by, concerning, for, from, [idiom] hath, in(-to), near, (out) of, over, through, to(-ward), under, unto, upon, whether, with(-in).
tokens.explanation: el — preposição de direção: a, para, em direção a

tokens.bdb: properly, the flank; but used only figuratively, the rear or recess
tokens.kjv: border, coast, part, quarter, side.

tokens.bdb: a (sea-going) vessel (as ceiled with a deck)
tokens.kjv: ship.

tokens.bdb: to lie down (for rest, sexual connection, decease or any other purpose)
tokens.kjv: [idiom] at all, cast down, (lover-)lay (self) (down), (make to) lie (down, down to sleep, still with), lodge, ravish, take rest, sleep, stay.

tokens.bdb: to stun, i.e. stupefy (with sleep or death)
tokens.kjv: (be fast a-, be in a deep, cast into a dead, that) sleep(-er, -eth).
